top_signals.title: Iran Security Shake-up; China Attempts to Close AI Gap with US | The Pulse 8/10/2026
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Jennifer McKeown, Capital Economics Chief Global Economist; Francesca Ghiretti, RAND Director of the Europe China Initiative; Robert Friedland, Sunrise Energy Metals Chairman,  Ivanhoe Electric Board of Directors Executive Chairman and I-Pulse Chairman & CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: House Dems call for AI companies to testify on recent hacks: ‘Clear risk to safety’
top_signals.summary: A group of House Democrats is calling on leaders of Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies to testify in Congress about recent hacking incidents.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Shein faces existential threat as tariffs hit low-price model, putting new focus on services
top_signals.summary: Shein has won over consumers with its low prices but is now seeing shoppers flee after new tariffs and changing regulations forced it to raise prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
